summary: Omega Flex, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on September 18, 2026, attaching a press release announcing a regular quarterly dividend of $0.34 per share to all shareholders of record as of September 30, 2026, payable October 14, 2026. The board of directors declared the dividend; no advisor was named. The filing is a routine capital-return announcement under Item 8.01, not a special situation. The company stated it will review cash needs, operations, financial condition, capital expenditures and possible acquisitions each quarter. What to watch: no risk-arb angle; the only forward item is the board's ongoing quarterly dividend determination.
